title: Brand new 2 bedroom guest house close to downtown.
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located house.  Brand new  guest house with private parking and private entrance located in East Nashville, one of Nashville's hottest neighborhoods.  Just over a mile from Nissan Stadium for concerts and football games or head downtown for those looking to honky-tonk. You can also walk or scooter to all the fun neighborhood shops, bars and restaurants.  With a full kitchen, outdoor patio space and washer/dryer, this property does not disappoint.

Other things to note
If you have a larger party, our neighbors also have an airbnb studio right next door.
